manaNeeded: {2}{B}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {2}{B}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Garna either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Garna, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it, Priest of Gix and Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
